1804:     """Flex Prefill sparse attention function. If query length is 1, will use flash decoding attention.
1805: 
1806:     Args:
1807:         q (torch.Tensor): query tensor, shape [batch_size, q_len, num_q_heads, head_dim]
1808:         k (torch.Tensor): key tensor, shape [batch_size, kv_len, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
1809:         v (torch.Tensor): value tensor, shape [batch_size, kv_len, num_kv_heads, head_dim]
1810:         gamma (float): attention coverage ratio, (0, 1).
1811:         tau (float, optional): query aware head threshold, [0, 1]. Defaults to 0.
1812:         min_budget (int, optional): minimum number of calculated tokens. Defaults to None.
1813:         max_budget (int, optional): maximum number of calculated tokens. Defaults to None.
1814:         gqa_interleave (bool, optional): GQA pattern. Defaults to False.
1815:         softmax_scale (Optional[float], optional): softmax scale. Defaults to None, which means sqrt(head_dim).
1816:         block_size (int, optional): block size. Defaults to 128.
1817:         return_computational_ratio (bool, optional): whether to return computation ratio. Defaults to False.
1818: 
1819:     Returns:
1820:         Union[torch.Tensor, Tuple[torch.Tensor, float]]: if return_computational_ratio is True, return attention output, else return attention output and computation ratio.
1821:     """
1822:     batch_size, q_len, num_q_heads, head_dim = q.shape
1823:     batch_size, k_len, num_kv_heads, head_dim = k.shape
1824:     assert batch_size == 1, "only support batch size 1 for now"
1825:     if q_len == 1:
1826:         if gqa_interleave:
1827:             attn_out = triton_flash_attention(
1828:                 q, k, v, softmax_scale=softmax_scale, gqa_interleave=True
1829:             )
1830:         else:
1831:             attn_out = flash_attn_func(q, k, v, softmax_scale=softmax_scale)
1832:         if return_computational_ratio:
1833:             return attn_out, 1
1834:         else:
1835:             return attn_out
1836:     assert q.shape[1] == k.shape[1]
1837:     assert head_dim in {16, 32, 64, 128}
1838:     assert block_size in {16, 32, 64, 128}
1839:     num_blocks = math.ceil(q_len / block_size)
1840:     min_budget = 1 if min_budget is None else min_budget
1841:     max_budget = 2147483647 if max_budget is None else max_budget
1842:     if q_len <= max(2 * block_size, math.ceil(min_budget / block_size) * block_size):
1843:         if gqa_interleave:
1844:             attn_out = triton_flash_attention(
1845:                 q, k, v, softmax_scale=softmax_scale, causal=True, gqa_interleave=True
1846:             )
1847:         else:
1848:             attn_out = flash_attn_func(
1849:                 q, k, v, softmax_scale=softmax_scale, causal=True
1850:             )
1851:         if return_computational_ratio:
1852:             return attn_out, 1
1853:         else:
1854:             return attn_out
1855:     # get vertical slash index
1856:     block_idx = get_active_blocks(
1857:         q,
1858:         k,
1859:         v,
1860:         block_size,
1861:         gamma,
1862:         math.ceil(min_budget / block_size),
1863:         math.ceil(max_budget / block_size),
1864:         tau,
1865:         gqa_interleave,
1866:     )
1867:     if return_computational_ratio:
1868:         activated_block_num = sum(
1869:             [
1870:                 block_idx[b][h].shape[-1]
1871:                 for b in range(len(block_idx))
1872:                 for h in range(len(block_idx[0]))
1873:             ]
1874:         )
1875:         total_block_num = num_blocks * num_blocks * len(block_idx) * len(block_idx[0])
1876:         computational_ratio = activated_block_num / total_block_num
1877:     attn_out = triton_block_wise_attention(
1878:         q,
1879:         k,
1880:         v,
1881:         block_idx,
1882:         block_size,
1883:         softmax_scale=softmax_scale,
1884:         gqa_interleave=gqa_interleave,
1885:     )
1886:     if return_computational_ratio:
1887:         return attn_out, computational_ratio
1888:     else:
1889:         return attn_out

103: def prefill_kernel(
104:     q_ptr,  # Q: b x n x h x d
105:     k_ptr,  # K: b x n x h x d
106:     v_ptr,  # V: b x n x h x d
107:     o_ptr,
108:     # shape
109:     BATCH_SIZE,
110:     NUM_HEADS,
111:     NUM_KV_HEADS,
112:     NUM_SHARE_Q_HEADS,
113:     Q_LEN,
114:     K_LEN,
115:     HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
116:     # softmax_scale
117:     softmax_scale,
118:     # causal
119:     causal,
120:     # gqa
121:     gqa_interleave,
122:     # stride
123:     stride_qb,
124:     stride_qn,
125:     stride_qh,
126:     stride_qd,
127:     stride_kb,
128:     stride_kn,
129:     stride_kh,
130:     stride_kd,
131:     stride_vb,
132:     stride_vn,
133:     stride_vh,
134:     stride_vd,
135:     stride_ob,
136:     stride_on,
137:     stride_oh,
138:     stride_od,
139:     # META parameters
140:     BLOCK_SIZE_Q: tl.constexpr,  # q block size
141:     BLOCK_SIZE_K: tl.constexpr,  # k block size
142: ):
143:     # get batch id and head id
144:     pid_q = tl.program_id(0)
145:     pid_bh = tl.program_id(1)
146:     pid_b = pid_bh // NUM_HEADS
147:     pid_h = pid_bh % NUM_HEADS
148:     if gqa_interleave:
149:         pid_kh = pid_h % NUM_KV_HEADS
150:     else:
151:         pid_kh = pid_h // NUM_SHARE_Q_HEADS
152:     # init qkv pointer
153:     q_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
154:         base=q_ptr + pid_b * stride_qb + pid_h * stride_qh,
155:         shape=(Q_LEN, HEAD_DIM),
156:         strides=(stride_qn, stride_qd),
157:         offsets=(pid_q * BLOCK_SIZE_Q, 0),
158:         block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_Q, HEAD_DIM),
159:         order=(1, 0),
160:     )
161:     k_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
162:         base=k_ptr + pid_b * stride_kb + pid_kh * stride_kh,
163:         shape=(HEAD_DIM, K_LEN),
164:         strides=(stride_kd, stride_kn),
165:         offsets=(0, 0),
166:         block_shape=(HEAD_DIM, BLOCK_SIZE_K),
167:         order=(0, 1),
168:     )
169:     v_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
170:         base=v_ptr + pid_b * stride_vb + pid_kh * stride_vh,
171:         shape=(K_LEN, HEAD_DIM),
172:         strides=(stride_vn, stride_vd),
173:         offsets=(0, 0),
174:         block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_K, HEAD_DIM),
175:         order=(1, 0),
176:     )
177:     # load q
178:     q = tl.load(q_ptrs, boundary_check=(0, 1), padding_option="zero")
179:     # init statistics
180:     off_m = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_Q) + pid_q * BLOCK_SIZE_Q
181:     off_n = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
182:     m_i = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_Q,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
183:     lse_i = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_Q,), float("-inf"), dtype=tl.float32)
184:     acc_o = tl.full((BLOCK_SIZE_Q, HEAD_DIM), 0, dtype=tl.float32)
185:     # full attention or causal attention
186:     lo = 0
187:     if causal:
188:         hi = min(K_LEN, (pid_q + 1) * BLOCK_SIZE_Q)
189:     else:
190:         hi = K_LEN
191:     for i in range(lo, hi, BLOCK_SIZE_K):
192:         i = tl.multiple_of(i, BLOCK_SIZE_K)
193:         # load k
194:         k = tl.load(k_ptrs, boundary_check=(1,), padding_option="zero")
195:         # compute qk
196:         qk = tl.zeros((BLOCK_SIZE_Q, BLOCK_SIZE_K), dtype=tl.float32)
197:         if causal:
198:             qk += tl.where(off_m[:, None] >= (i + off_n)[None, :], 0, float("-inf"))
199:         else:
200:             qk += tl.where((off_n < K_LEN - i)[None, :], 0, float("-inf"))
201:         qk += tl.dot(q, k) * softmax_scale
202:         # compute m_ij and l_ij
203:         m_ij = tl.maximum(m_i, tl.max(qk, axis=1))
204:         p = tl.math.exp2(qk - m_ij[:, None])
205:         l_ij = tl.sum(p, axis=1)
206:         # scale acc_o
207:         acc_o_scale = tl.math.exp2(m_i - m_ij)
208:         acc_o = acc_o * acc_o_scale[:, None]
209:         # load v and update acc_o
210:         v = tl.load(v_ptrs, boundary_check=(0,), padding_option="zero")
211:         p = p.to(v.dtype)
212:         acc_o += tl.dot(p, v)
213:         # update statistics
214:         m_i = m_ij
215:         lse_i = m_ij + tl.math.log2(tl.math.exp2(lse_i - m_ij) + l_ij)
216:         # update ptrs
217:         k_ptrs = tl.advance(k_ptrs, (0, BLOCK_SIZE_K))
218:         v_ptrs = tl.advance(v_ptrs, (BLOCK_SIZE_K, 0))
219:     # final scale
220:     acc_o = acc_o * tl.math.exp2(m_i - lse_i)[:, None]
221:     # save output
222:     o_ptrs = tl.make_block_ptr(
223:         base=o_ptr + pid_b * stride_ob + pid_h * stride_oh,
224:         shape=(Q_LEN, HEAD_DIM),
225:         strides=(stride_on, stride_od),
226:         offsets=(pid_q * BLOCK_SIZE_Q, 0),
227:         block_shape=(BLOCK_SIZE_Q, HEAD_DIM),
228:         order=(1, 0),
229:     )
230:     tl.store(o_ptrs, acc_o.to(tl.bfloat16), boundary_check=(0,))

1680:             "bihgd, bjhgd -> bhgij",
1681:             last_q.view(
1682:                 last_q.shape[0], last_q.shape[1], -1, num_share_q_heads, head_dim

1684:             k.view(k.shape[0], k.shape[1], -1, 1, head_dim),
1685:         )
1686:     else:

1689:             last_q.view(
1690:                 last_q.shape[0], last_q.shape[1], num_share_q_heads, -1, head_dim
1691:             ),
1692:             k.view(k.shape[0], k.shape[1], 1, -1, head_dim),
1693:         )

1695:     if causal_mask is None:

1697:         causal_mask = causal_mask[:, None] >= causal_mask[None, :]
1698:         causal_mask = causal_mask[None, None, None, ...]

1700:         ~causal_mask[..., :block_size, :block_size], float("-inf")

1704:     qk = rearrange(qk, "b h g i j -> b (h g) i j")

1706:     vertical = qk.mean(-2)
1707:     # get vertical slash size to make sure attention score >= gamma. shape: [batch_size, num_heads]
1708:     num_vertical_blocks = score_cover_topk(vertical, gamma) // 128 + 1
1709:     num_slash_blocks = score_cover_topk(slash, gamma) // 128 + 1
1710:     num_vertical_blocks[num_vertical_blocks < min_budget] = min_budget
1711:     num_vertical_blocks[num_vertical_blocks > max_budget] = max_budget
1712:     num_slash_blocks[num_slash_blocks < min_budget] = min_budget
1713:     num_slash_blocks[num_slash_blocks > max_budget] = max_budget
1714:     # block avg pool
1715:     vertical = torch_bhn_sumpool(vertical, block_size)
1716:     slash = torch_bhn_sumpool(slash, block_size)
1717:     # get block sparse mask
1718:     if not gqa_interleave:
1719:         avg_k = triton_bnhd_pool(k, block_size).repeat_interleave(num_share_q_heads, 2)
1720:     else:
1721:         avg_k = triton_bnhd_pool(k, block_size).repeat(1, 1, num_share_q_heads, 1)
1722:     avg_qk = torch.einsum(
1723:         "bihd, bjhd -> bhij", last_q.mean(1, keepdim=True), avg_k
1724:     ).squeeze(2)

1726:     kl_div = square_root_js_divergence(avg_qk, vertical)
1727:     block_sparse_mask = kl_div < tau
1728:     num_vertical_blocks[block_sparse_mask] = min_budget
1729:     num_slash_blocks[block_sparse_mask] = min_budget
1730:     # keep first vertical and slash block
1731:     vertical[..., :1] = torch.inf
1732:     slash[..., -1:] = torch.inf
1733:     # get slash topk
1734:     num_slash_blocks = num_slash_blocks.view(batch_size * num_heads)
1735:     slash = slash.view(batch_size * num_heads, -1)
1736:     slash_topk = (num_blocks - 1) - slash.topk(
1737:         min(num_slash_blocks.max().item(), num_blocks), -1
1738:     ).indices
1739:     slash_topk[
1740:         torch.arange(slash_topk.shape[-1], device=num_slash_blocks.device)[None, :]

1742:     ] = 0
1743:     slash_topk = slash_topk.view(batch_size, num_heads, -1)

1751:         torch.arange(vertical_topk.shape[-1], device=num_vertical_blocks.device)[

1753:         ]
